title: Grateful Dead Live at Felt Forum, Madison Square Garden on 1971-12-05

ai_review.summary: Excellent soundboard capture of the classic Dec 5 1971 Felt Forum show, highlighted by stellar Jack Straw, Sugaree, Tennessee Jed and Comes a Time performances.
ai_review.review: The Miller‑remastered SBD release is praised as the definitive version of this historic New York concert, delivering crystal‑clear audio that lets listeners hear early renditions of Jack Straw, Sugaree, Tennessee Jed and the iconic Comes a Time. Reviewers rave about the band’s high energy and Keith Godchaux’s emerging prowess, noting only a few neutral comments but overall a very positive reception.

ai_rating.rationale: Consistently high reviewer scores (average 4.4) and strong praise for both the musical performance and soundboard quality justify a rating near the top of the scale.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Multiple reviewers call this the definitive, upgraded version with crisp, clear mix; no complaints about dropouts or muddiness.

standout_songs: Washed My Hands In Muddy Water
show_quality.setlist_flow: Classic 71/72 era set, showcasing early versions of several staples; flow described as solid and historically significant.

band_member_comments.Keys: Keith Godchaux is noted as coming into his own and adding depth to the performance.
